title: Destiny Inscription
next_chapter_hook: Just as Hei Xuanwu was being dragged into the heavenly prison, a dimensional rift unrelated to this world appeared above the imperial capital—the aura leaking from that crack made Chen Ji's fingers gripping the Tianji Record suddenly tighten.

text.content:
Imperial Capital, Altar of Heavenly Sacrifice.

Ling Yuan. This name was like an ice awl, stabbing viciously into Chen Ji's Mental Sea. The fragments of fate lingering in the Tianji Record from the previous chapter's ending still echoed, but he had no time to ponder.

Because today, before the eyes of the entire world, he was about to do something that would be recorded in history.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself) Ling Yuan... you've been lurking in the shadows watching my strategy, but now I'll shatter these chess pieces on the board for you, one by one.

text.content:
At the hour of si (9-11am), the Altar of Heavenly Sacrifice.

Chen Ji wore a plain white robe, slowly ascending ninety-nine steps of white jade. The morning breeze stirred his garments, and on his seemingly timid and mediocre face, there was now a terrifying calm.

dialogue.content:
Distinguished officials, there is something I must announce today.

(His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached every person present) Hei Xuanwu, if you still wish to argue, perhaps you should look up at the sky.

text.content: Hei Xuanwu stood at the head of the ministers, his face filled with mockery. He was an Outer Sect Elder of the Xuanwu Sect, having controlled the imperial capital's secret guards for three years, with the entire Old Heavenly Dao Guardian Alliance standing behind him. In his view, this worthless menial servant was nothing but a clown.

dialogue.content:
(Cold laugh) Chen Ji, as a menial servant disciple, what qualification do you have to speak nonsense at the Altar of Heavenly Sacrifice? This old man advises you to understand your place—

Before he could finish, golden light suddenly erupted.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment manifested in Chen Ji's palm, and three thousand golden inscriptions rose into the air like swimming dragons, instantly filling the entire sky above the imperial capital. The hundred officials looked up in horror, and within that golden light, countless scenes flashed by like a carousel—

dialogue.content:
(Calmly) Three years ago, you signed a secret contract with the Old Heavenly Dao Guardian Alliance.

(Pointing to the sky projection) This is the first secret letter. You said—'The Tianqing Sect's fortune has run out, the old master is about to return, Xuanwu is willing to be the inside agent.'

text.content: In the golden projection, Hei Xuanwu's familiar face was clearly visible, his handwritten script exposed under the sunlight. The entire court officials drew a cold breath, and murmurs rose like a tide.

dialogue.content:
No... impossible! How could a worthless menial servant possibly—

(His voice trembling) This is forged! It's all forged!

text.content:
A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips, but it didn't reach his eyes.

The second projection lit up—records of Hei Xuanwu secretly transmitting intelligence to the Tianqing Sect. The third, the fourth... over three years, twenty-seven secret letters, every piece solid evidence.

dialogue.content: Forged? (Light laugh) Hei Xuanwu, did you think the 'Tianji Seal' of the Old Heavenly Dao Guardian Alliance was just decoration? Unfortunately, their technology is too backward—in my eyes, it's like transparent.

text.content: Hei Xuanwu's legs went weak, and he collapsed to the ground. His once arrogant face was now contorted into a grayish white. The surrounding ministers all retreated, as if he were some kind of flood or beast.

dialogue.content: (A clear, cold voice sounded from Chen Ji's side) Xuanwu Guards, hear the order—immediately arrest the twenty-seven members of Hei Xuanwu's faction, those who dare resist, kill on the spot.

text.content: Ye Qing appeared from the shadows in a jet-black battle armor. Behind her, the Xuanwu Guards surged forth like a black tide, completely surrounding Hei Xuanwu's faction. Those secret guards who had usually acted tyrants were now as pale as death, kneeling and begging for mercy.

choice.prompt: Hei Xuanwu lay limp on the ground, and all the officials waited for Chen Ji's final judgment. The power of fate-writing was ready to be unleashed. How do you choose to deal with this traitor?

choices.description: Engrave Hei Xuanwu's crimes into the depths of his soul, making him unable to live or die, and announce to the world in the cruelest way possible—traitors shall never be reborn for eternity.
choices.visible_reward: Reputation greatly increases, the world is shocked, members of the Old Heavenly Dao Guardian Alliance will be unable to sleep at night
choices.risk_hint: Excessive display of the Tianji Record's power may attract more attention

text.content:
Chen Ji raised his hand, and the Tianji Record's golden light blazed brilliantly. He looked down at the collapsed Hei Xuanwu, his voice as flat as if describing the weather:

'Since Lord Hei likes to hide in the shadows, then let him stay in the shadows forever.'

A golden inscription shot out from the Tianji Record and pierced into Hei Xuanwu's brow center.

dialogue.content:
Ah—！！

(Piercing scream) Chen Ji! You wretch... what are you doing to me... my soul... my memories...！！

choices.description: Carve his three years of crimes before all eyes, keep him alive as a living testimony, showing mercy while making death preferable to life—living under the world's contempt is the greatest punishment.
choices.visible_reward: Benevolent name spreads far, secretly winning over some wavering forces
choices.risk_hint: Some forces may think you soft and easy to bully

text.content:
Chen Ji withdrew his hovering finger, the light of the Tianji Record dimming slightly.

"Death? Too merciful for you."

He walked slowly to the Black Xuanwu, gazing down at this once-arrogant elder of the Xuanwu Sect.

dialogue.content:
(Calmly) Three years of crimes, proclaimed to the world. You'll never wash away this stain. Black Xuanwu, didn't you value reputation most?

(Leaning slightly forward) Then carry this brand and live well.

choices.text: Beat the grass to frighten the tiger
choices.description: Publicly judge Black Xuanwu, but subtly point the finger at the Old Heavenly Secrets Guardians Alliance behind him—without explicitly revealing it, yet making everyone present think of that invisible net.
choices.visible_cost: Not as satisfying as direct crushing
choices.visible_reward: Hints that the layout succeeded, the Old Heavenly Secrets Guardians Alliance will begin mutual suspicion internally
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the forces behind the scenes to act prematurely

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't look at Black Xuanwu, but swept his gaze across the court officials.

"Does anyone know where an Outer Sect elder of the Xuanwu Sect got the audacity to betray the Tianqing Sect?"

At these words, everyone's expression changed. This was an obvious warning—Black Xuanwu was merely a chess piece; the real opponents lurk behind.

dialogue.content:
(With deep meaning) Today is merely the beginning. I said—if anyone dares to stretch out their hand, I'll cut it off. As for whose hand it is connected to...

(Turning around) Everyone here should know in their hearts.

text.content: All officials fell silent, not daring to breathe. On the memorial platform, golden inscriptions continued flowing slowly, projecting all of Black Xuanwu's three years of crimes across the sky. Those officials who once called Black Xuanwu brother now lowered their heads, afraid of being implicated.

dialogue.content:
(Whispering near Chen Ji's ear) All twenty-seven have been captured. The capital is shaken, the court is in an uproar—this move of yours is even crueler than my Demonic Path's executioners.

(Smiling lightly) Chen Ji, are you truly just atrash servant?

text.content:
Chen Ji put away the Tianji Record, his gaze passing over Ye Qing's enigmatic expression.

"Your Highness the Saintess is jesting."

(Turning to leave) The show is over. Time to go back for tea.

At that moment, the sky suddenly changed.

The clear sky suddenly darkened, and a pitch-black rift silently tore open above the capital. From within that rift emanated a chilling, otherworldly aura that transcended this world.

dialogue.content:
(Pausing mid-step, fingers suddenly tightening)

This is...

(Thinking internally) A dimensional rift? No, this world shouldn't have such things—unless someone deliberately summoned it.

(Gaze sweeping toward the rift's depths, pupils contracting) Ling Yuan... You've finally made your move?

text.content:
Officials scattered in fear, only Chen Ji stood firm, gazing up at that inhuman scar in the sky.

Ye Qing's expression turned grave, her Xuanwu Blade already unsheathed: "Chen Ji, that thing's aura... is not from this world."

Chen Ji offered no reply. He simply stared quietly at the rift, the Tianji Record in his sleeve burning hot—fate fragments were frantically warning him.

Within that dimensional rift, a colossal eye slowly emerged—the pupil ink-black as ink, yet the iris burned with searing golden flames.

The Eye of Heavenly Secrets.

Chen Ji's entire body went rigid. This was the second time he had seen this eye. The first time was when he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment.

That eye held no emotion, yet it filled everyone present with a fear beyond language. It simply watched quietly—for something—

Watching Black Xuanwu, who had already been escorted to the celestial prison.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, alarm bells ringing in his heart.

"Ye Qing!"

He spun around abruptly, his voice carrying an urgency rarely heard: "Get Black Xuanwu out of the capital immediately! That eye isn't here to observe—it's here to silence witnesses!"

However, it was already too late.

The rift suddenly expanded, and a devastating force poured forth, striking precisely toward the celestial prison. Black thunder exploded, accompanied by a凄厉 scream—

Black Xuanwu, utterly annihilated.

Along with the evidence of crimes inscribed in his soul, it was all completely erased by that Eye of Heavenly Secrets.

dialogue.content:
(Staring fixedly at the sky's eye, fists white-knuckled)

Good... very good...

(Thinking internally) Ling Yuan, you're ruthless enough. Knowing Black Xuanwu would implicate you, so you used the Eye of Heavenly Secrets to eliminate the witness directly. And the evidence I just inscribed in Black Xuanwu's soul... was erased along with him.

(Corner of mouth curling into a cold smile) You think this lets you sleep soundly? Black Xuanwu is dead, but his twenty-seven accomplices are still alive.

text.content:
The Eye of Heavenly Secrets slowly turned, as if searching for something. Finally, its gaze fell upon Chen Ji.

In that instant, Chen Ji felt his very soul laid bare. The Tianji Record in his sleeve violently trembled, as if in terror.

Yet that eye simply watched him for a moment, then slowly withdrew, sinking back into the dimensional rift.

dialogue.content:
(Urgent) Chen Ji, are you alright?

(Looking at his pale face, frown deepening) That eye just now... the way it looked at you, it didn't seem like it was seeing you for the first time. Does it know you?

text.content:
Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, composed his expression, and turned to face the frightened officials.

"Your Excellencies, please forgive the shock."

His voice returned to its usual placidity, as if that scene had been nothing more than a trivial interlude.

"Black Xuanwu has committed treason and betrayed the sect, and has already received heavenly punishment. There is no need for alarm—"(His gaze swept across the crowd) "However, from today onward, the Tianqing Sect will conduct a thorough investigation of all forces connected to the former Heavenly Dao Guardian Alliance. If any of you have information, it would be best to come forward voluntarily."

The officials exchanged glances, but none dared to voice any doubt. Today's scene had left too deep an impression on them—Black Xuanwu's betrayal, those damning secret letters, and that terrifying eye descending from the heavens to silence...

This disciple, once dismissed as worthless, had now etched an indelible shadow into their hearts.

dialogue.content:
(After the crowd dispersed, in a low voice) Chen Ji, the Ling Yuan you mentioned earlier... is he connected to that eye?

(His expression grave) In our Demonic Path, we too have heard whispers of the "Eye of Heavenly Dao." It is said to stand above all powers—even our Holy Sect dares not speak of it lightly.

(Meeting Chen Ji's gaze directly) How much do you truly know?

text.content:
Chen Ji looked at Ye Qing's intently probing eyes and suddenly smiled.

"Holy Maiden, there are some things—the more you know, the faster you die."

(Turning to leave) "You only need to know one thing—our enemy is far more terrifying than you can imagine. Therefore, the cooperation between us must grow even closer."

dialogue.content:
(Back turned to Ye Qing, voice low) Also—help me investigate a name. Ling Yuan. Former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect.

(A pause) "I need to know everything he has done all these years. Every detail."

(Fist clenching slightly in his sleeve) "This game... is far larger than I anticipated."

text.content: At the very moment Black Xuanwu was dragged into the celestial prison, a dimensional rift—foreign to this world—appeared above the imperial capital. The aura seeping from that crack made Chen Ji's fingers tighten abruptly around the Tianji Record—the chess game of destiny is accelerating its pace.
